title: Hotel Check-in
objective: Check in at a hotel, confirm your booking and ask about facilities and breakfast.
aiRole: a receptionist at the hotel front desk
learnerRole: a guest who has just arrived with a reservation
opening: Good afternoon, welcome to the Riverside Hotel. Do you have a reservation with us?
targetSentences: I have a reservation under Chen.
Is there wifi in the room?
Could I have some extra towels?
